_readme: Export allowlists for scripts/safe_export.py. A profile is a deliberate decision about what may leave CSI (CLAUDE.md §7.2). Adding a column here is a data-protection decision, not a convenience. Never add a column carrying decedent or family data; the tool refuses anyway, but the refusal is the backstop, not the control.

rates_published.description: Published rate card. Commercial terms only, no shipment or person data.

funeral_homes_business.description: Funeral home accounts as businesses. Business identity and booking counts only. Excludes email and phone so the file is safe for an adviser or diligence room; use funeral_homes_internal for CRM work.

funeral_homes_internal.description: As above plus business contact details. Internal and partner use only. NOT for a diligence room.

analytics_monthly.description: Aggregate monthly performance. Safe for lenders and advisers.
